Deliver [[Undertaker Cortis]]'s casualty report to [[Warmaster Tydus]], in Ascalon City.

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = prophecies
}}

===Objectives===
* Deliver the [[Casualty Report (item)|Casualty Report]] to Warmaster Tydus.
* Return to Undertaker Cortis for your reward.

===Reward===
* 150 [[Experience]]
* 50 {{gold}} ({{reforgedmode}} only)
* {{n}} {{skill icon|Shadow Strike}}

==Walkthrough==
Simply map travel to Ascalon City and talk to Warmaster Tydus, then return to Undertaker Cortis for your reward.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Undertaker Cortis
:''"I have now compiled a list of casualities resulting from this military action. Please take this report to '''Warmaster Tydus''' in '''Ascalon City'''. This would normally be my task, but I fear my duties here are not yet complete.''

:''Will you help me?"''
{{Offer dialog
| accept = I'll take the report to Tydus.
| decline = I am no messenger.
| ask = Take the casualty report to Warmaster Tydus in Ascalon City.
}}

===Intermediate dialogue===
;Warmaster Tydus
:''"The casualty report from Piken Square? Let's have a look at this. Dwayna preserve me, we've lost many a good soldier. We cannot continue to pay this kind of cost for a meaningless gain like Piken Square. Barradin was a fool to forge ahead so recklessly. The Vanguard are our best and brightest, but what use are they if they are thrown into the grinder like this? Forgive my tone, <Character name>, but I fear that we are losing this war. Return to Cortis and tell him to send me regular reports. I must monitor this situation carefully."''

===Reward dialogue===
;Undertaker Cortis
:''"So I am to be caught in the middle of some argument between Tydus and Barradin? Not a position to be in I'm sure you'll agree. However, it is not fault of yours and you have performed your duties admirably."''

==Notes==
* All professions can do this quest, but only [[necromancer]]s get a skill as a reward.
* This is a ''non-repeatable'' quest. If completed under any other profession(s), this skill reward will have to be acquired from a [[skill trainer]].
* This quest continues the storyline of [[Fallen Soldiers]], even though this quest can be completed before Fallen Soldiers.
